items.q: What should you remember about **Frontier Math shock**?
items.a: **Epoch AI hired mathematicians globally to benchmark** LLMs; Ono couldn't easily write questions models failed; months of early access before public caught up.

items.q: What should you remember about **Wrong race**?
items.a: **"Stay ahead of AI" on** knowledge = motorcycle vs Bolt; Olympics still matter despite machine physical superiority.

items.q: What should you remember about **Librarian, not surgeon**?
items.a: **LLMs excel at retrieval;** human judgment essential for high-stakes inference (medicine, aviation, novel science).

items.q: What should you remember about **Knowledge vs intelligence split**?
items.a: **facts cheap; creating concepts,** cross-field pattern transfer, and "targets of opportunity" = genius.

items.q: What should you remember about **Niche commitment intelligence**?
items.a: **daily expert grind in** one field is a form of genius schools under-recognize.

items.q: What should you remember about **Ramanujan as hope**?
items.a: **father's hero was a dropout mystic, not** Harvard perfect student; letter from Janaki Ammal (Ramanujan's widow) rekindled Ono's path after high-school dropout.

items.q: What should you remember about **Spirit of Ramanujan**?
items.a: **fellowship program finding undiscovered** talent (e.g. Karina Hong); many Ramanujans likely exist without privilege.

items.q: What should you remember about **$80K/year vs LLM**?
items.a: **academic book knowledge replicable via** LLM at own pace; missing piece = human mentors deriving right/next questions.

items.q: What should you remember about **AI as tutor, not replacement**?
items.a: **LLM won't laugh at** "dumb" questions; precision learning + adjacent-field exploration without shame.

items.q: What should you remember about **Checkbox education critique**?
items.a: **test scores, GPA, right college** pipeline stress students from middle school; participate but recognize the system.

items.q: What should you remember about **Wonder preservation**?
items.a: **infant block-play = gravity** experiments; bottle kindergarten energy before reputation anxiety kills curiosity.

items.q: What should you remember about **Student debt purgatory**?
items.a: **$350K+ debt discovering you** hate your profession; identity owned by loans not passion.
